title: A Week With an
<g>AI Ops Team</g>
subtitle: Same week every week. It gets better each Friday.

cards.title: The week starts itself
cards.body: A timer kicks off every room. Nobody presses start.

cards.title: Drafts land in one inbox
cards.body: Emails, posts, reports. Scored before I see them.

cards.title: I approve in minutes
cards.body: Yes, edit or no. Nothing leaves without it.

cards.title: It checks what worked
cards.body: Replies, reach, paid invoices. Real numbers only.

cards.title: It proposes one upgrade
cards.body: A change to how it works, for me to accept.
